info.name: GridCraft integration
info.summary: Edit Excel spreadsheets in Nextcloud with GridCraft
info.description:
Open an Excel workbook (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb, .xls), an OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods) or a CSV file in Files with **Edit in GridCraft** and work on it right in the browser: formulas and functions, formatting, tables, charts, PivotTables, sorting and filtering, notes and comments.
- **Save** writes an .xlsx workbook straight back to Nextcloud, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. Other formats are saved as a new .xlsx file next to the original (you pick the name and folder). - **Export as PDF** stores a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a spreadsheet in Files opens it in GridCraft.
GridCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [GridCraft](https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native spreadsheet app. It embeds a build of GridCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
